page_title: HAV 2-2 REN | Le Havre v Rennes 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
90+2' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) is about to take a corner kick.
90+1' Habib Beye has decided to substitute Esteban Lepaul and he is replaced by Mousa Tamari (Rennes).
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) replaces Rassoul Ndiaye.
88' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) sends the corner into the box, but Mory Diaw intercepts it and averts the threat.
88' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
82' Damian Pizarro (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

79' 2 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom right corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Damian Pizarro (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch so that Simon Ebonog can be given a rest.
78' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) replaces Loic Nego.
74' Rough tackle by Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Le Havre.
71' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Rennes players look gutted.
71' The Rennes players halt their celebrations as referee Jeremie Pignard makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

70' It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Breel Embolo (Rennes). Alidu Seidu plays a fantastic through ball and finds Breel Embolo (Rennes), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:3.

69' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremie Pignard no option but to blow his whistle. Rennes are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
68' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
64' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Valentin Rongier (Rennes) is given a yellow card.
64' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) replacing Felix Mambimbi.
64' Here is a change. Younes Namli is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Fode Doucoure (Le Havre).
63' A substitution has been made. Djaoui Cisse is replaced by Seko Fofana (Rennes).
63' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Breel Embolo (Rennes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
58' 5:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
54' Loic Nego (Le Havre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
53' Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre). A free kick has been awarded to Rennes.

49' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
48' Rennes are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Brice Samba gets a hand on the penalty from Issa Soumare (Le Havre), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
45' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jeremie Pignard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
45' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) makes a strong challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. Le Havre are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
42' A rebound falls kindly for Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
41' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) commits a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Le Havre.
38' The ball is out of play. Le Havre will have a chance to score from a corner.
38' Loic Nego (Le Havre) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Le Havre will have a throw-in.
37' The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
35' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) for a tough tackle.

32' The most active player in today's match is definitely Esteban Lepaul (Rennes). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
29' 0 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Esteban Lepaul (Rennes), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:2.
27' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
25' Celebrations are cut short for Rennes as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
24' Wait! Referee Jeremie Pignard has indicated he is going to review the Rennes goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
23' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
23' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
22' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Total attempts – 1:4.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Loic Nego (Le Havre). The ball has crossed the sideline. Le Havre are taking a throw-in.
15' Le Havre will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

15' Younes Namli (Le Havre) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from Le Havre as they win a corner.
14' Corner kicks – 0:1.
10' 0 - 1 Breel Embolo (Rennes) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the middle of the goal.
9' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
9' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.
7' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
4' Le Havre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
